review_description: The installation of our solar panels and battery system was carried out by the Solai team with a high level of professionalism. The project was completed promptly and on schedule. Some small minor defects were identified, and remediated immediately. It demonstrates Anthony & Mathieu's commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. We are very pleased with both the workmanship and the service provided, and have already recommended this company to others.

I recently had an AlphaESS 20kWh battery system installed by SOLAI and the experience was excellent from start to finish. Mathieu and Anthony gave clear and honest advice from day 1 to help me choose the best option for my home, making sure it would work seamlessly with my SolarEdge system. The installation was on time, tidy, and very professional — everything was set up neatly and explained clearly. Since then, the system has run flawlessly and has delivered exactly as promised. It was a very good value proposition, I’m very happy with the service and wouldn’t hesitate to recommend SOLAI to anyone looking for a reliable solar and battery solution.

The sales process was respectful and friendly, no hard sell.They were quick and efficient and helped organise the grid and they even tidied up after themselves!Here are some details of the systemSystem size ~10.45kWPanel Brand: LongiInverter & Battery Brand: SigenergyBattery capacity: 16kWAfter a few months it's still producing more than we consume so we're happy.

We recently had solar panels installed at our home, and the entire experience was outstanding. I met Mathieu and Anthony through my workplace, and they were incredibly helpful from the very beginning. They provided a clear and competitive quote, explained the entire solar process in detail, and patiently answered every question my husband and I had—no matter how many we asked!Mathieu, in particular, went above and beyond, always available to respond to our inquiries, even outside of regular hours. The installation was smooth, tidy, and professionally done—no mess left behind. They also helped set up the app, making it easy for us to monitor our system, and ongoing support has been readily available whenever needed.I truly appreciate all the help and support we received and would highly recommend this business to anyone considering solar. Thank you again, Mathieu and Anthony!

I recently had a solar system installed (roof panels and battery) by Solai and couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, the process was smooth, transparent, and handled with the utmost professionalism.A big shoutout to Mathieu and Anthony, who were absolutely fantastic throughout the installation. They were punctual, knowledgeable, and went above and beyond to ensure everything was set up perfectly. They took the time to explain the system, answer all my questions, and made sure I was comfortable with how everything works before they left.The quality of workmanship was top-notch, and it's clear that Solai takes pride in their work. I highly recommend Solai to anyone considering solar—reliable service, great communication, and an excellent team. Thanks again for making the switch to solar such a great experience!

We recently had an 11.4kW solar system installed by Solai Energy Solutions and couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From the initial consultation to final installation, the team was knowledgeable, courteous, and truly professional.What stood out most was how well they listened to our needs. They tailored a system specifically for our household rather than pushing a one-size-fits-all package. Their attention to detail and meticulous approach gave us confidence at every step.Since the system went live, we've seen a dramatic drop in our power bills — a clear sign that the system is working exactly as promised. We're so impressed that we've already decided to go back to Solai for battery storage to complement the system and make the most of the new government rebate.If you're looking for a solar installer who knows their stuff and genuinely cares about delivering the best outcome for your home, we couldn't recommend Solai Energy Solutions highly enough.

As a business owner running a busy warehouse, I can't recommend SOLAI highly enough. They installed a 25kW solar system for us, and from start to finish the experience was top-notch. Mathieu and Antony, who handled the installation, were a pleasure to deal with—extremely knowledgeable, professional, and respectful of our operations. The install was seamless, with zero disruption to our day-to-day activities.What truly sets SOLAI apart, though, is their continued service after the sale. Six months post-installation, I was surprised and impressed to receive a call from their team notifying me that our inverter had gone offline. It turns out the issue was related to a change in our Internet service provider—something I hadn’t even thought of—but thanks to SOLAI’s proactive monitoring, we were able to resolve it quickly.It’s rare to find a company that combines technical expertise, outstanding service, and long-term support. SOLAI delivered on all fronts. Highly recommended for any business looking to make the switch to solar.
